method: Same config, components and platform (linux/arm64) as the benchmark's build phase, fresh artifact directory. The base image is served from a local registry (localhost:5001) and the 120-path Nix closure from a local HTTP mirror (127.0.0.1:8899) populated from cache.nixos.org, so no WAN download is on the critical path. Stats are from `oar --json build`; wall includes the CLI process.
config: runtime.base: localhost:5001/debian:trixie-slim; runtime.substituters: [http://127.0.0.1:8899]; components: nodejs_22, python313, git, binary:my-agent
